title: 1945 State Department document on Nazi-linked companies in Latin America

tellings.quote: So, there's a State Department document which talks about how this was in 1945, they'd already realized hundreds of new companies have been set up in Nicaragua and Argentina

plain: By 1945, according to a researcher named Jason Simosa, the US State Department, the government's foreign affairs office, had noticed a wave of new companies tied to Nazi Germany appearing in Latin America. He describes a State Department document from that year saying that "hundreds of new companies have been set up in Nicaragua and Argentina". Simosa summarises it in a discussion that draws on the writer Peter Levenda, and he raises it to suggest that Nazi money and people found new homes abroad after the war.
